quarantined_all_candidate_lanes_ceiling.interpretation: Candidate union is an optimistic planning ceiling. Targeted AI passes are not production approvals; every replacement must pass the complete frozen source-bound screen before training.

quarantined_candidate_union.audit_interpretation: The added rows are candidate translations screened by AI-only semantic and fluency checks, with no human-gold controls. They remain quarantined and are not admitted to the multilingual SFT corpus. Coverage changes are feasibility diagnostics only; they cannot show that a trained model will meet the pre-unlearning competence gate or support a causal unlearning comparison. The candidate review runtime also logged an SDPA sliding-window attention caveat. A direct Mistral cross-review disagreed with the initial Qwen screen on 154/187 rows; its deliberate-mismatch control passed 2/15, and the Qwen14 deliberate-mismatch screen passed 1/16. These small controls are not error-rate estimates, but they show that neither AI reviewer can certify the candidates.

quarantined_full799_candidate_union.audit_interpretation: Separate full flagged-question repair candidate union; optimistic AI-only coverage ceiling, not production approval.
